_README: Copy to index/index-config.json and fill in. Defines what THE PROJECT indexes — roots + file extensions — for the per-file detail (Format A). Typically filled in when the framework is installed: the extensions depend on the project's language, the framework doesn't assume them. Checked in READ mode by checks/index-check.py; edited in WRITE mode by index/manifest.py (set/rm/get/stamp).
_hub: Optional — path to a file (e.g. 'index/INDEX.md') carrying a '> Last updated: ...' line that `manifest.py stamp` will maintain (date + short commit). null = stamp disabled, no-op.
_eval-groups: Optional — array of manifest path prefixes (e.g. ['src/orders/', 'src/ui/']) that checks/index-eval/prefilter.py evaluates as groups. null/absent = groups derive from the manifest's own first-level directories.
_eval-stopwords: Optional — extra function words for the index-eval tokenizer, ADDED to its English default. Fill this in when the manifest's intents are not written in English: an unlisted function word counts as CONTENT, so two unrelated intents sharing 'des'/'les' look similar to the lexical prefilter and a query sharing them with its source intent looks contaminated to the anti-leakage guard. Both inflate a number instead of raising. Lowercase, no accents stripped (e.g. ['le','la','les','des','est','pour']).
